## Usage

```bash
drt sources [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--detailed` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Print per-connector fields, env vars, and sample YAML. |
| `--format`, `-o` | `TEXT` | `table` | Output format: 'table' (default) or 'json'. |
